In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the underworld conglomerate known as the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]], under the command of the disgraced [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], '''attacked''' [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in order to force [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], a prominent member of the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]], into cooperation with the Shadow Collective.

A junction between the criminal organizations of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], and the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] mining [[Pyke/Legends|Pykes]], the bulk of the attack was conducted by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian super commando/Legends|super commandos]] of the Death Watch, who attacked the perimeter of the Palace, paving the path for Darth Maul, Savage Opress, and Death Watch leader [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] into Jabba's inner sanctum. After a very brief and violent struggle proving the Shadow Collective to be the more formidable, Jabba agreed to surrender his criminal empire, channeling his resources to the organization's cause for an imminent [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|takeover]] of the Mandalorian capital city, [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|So the only thing you can tell me is that I will find Jabba at Jabba's Palace?|Darth Maul to Oruba the Hutt prior to his execution|<ref name="EMN" />}}
Following a [[Skirmish on Florrum/Legends|major defeat]] on the planet [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] at the hands of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and a ragtag band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] under the command of [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] were left for dead, only to be discovered in a wayward [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] by [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] and his band of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warriors known as the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]]. Maul promised Vizsla a conquest over the planet [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], home of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]]<ref name="ES">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> government of pacifists which the Death Watch refused to recognize.<ref name="MP">{{TCW|The Mandalore Plot}}</ref> In an effort to gain resources for his growing "[[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]]," Maul led a takeover of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate, ordering the execution of its top members and bringing the remainders under his own influence. Soon gaining the support of the [[Pyke/Legends|Pykes]], known for their [[Spice/Legends|spice]] mining, Maul decided to lead an attack on the planet [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] to bring the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]], the governing body of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] species and their criminal activities, under his control. Maul's appeal to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], who was present via hologram, ended in failure, and the Hutt council retreated as a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] that included [[Sugi (bounty hunter)/Legends|Sugi]], [[Embo/Legends|Embo]], and [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]], along with many Nikto guards, kept Maul, Opress, and the Mandalorian warriors at bay. In the aftermath of the skirmish, only [[Oruba/Legends|Oruba]] the Hutt remained on site, the bounty hunters had escaped, and all the Nikto guards were killed. Oruba promptly revealed the location of [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on the remote world [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Oruba was then executed by Opress.<ref name="EMN" />

==The mission==
{{Quote|Give up, Jabba, you're the only ones left!"<br />"Submit or suffer.|Pre Vizsla and Darth Maul to Jabba the Hutt in his inner sanctum|<ref name="EMN" />}}
[[File:SlicedHam-Eminence.png|thumb|left|250px|Maul, Savage and Vizsla slice their way into Jabba's throne room]]
Maul had Vizsla mobilize his soldiers and traveled to Jabba's fortress on Tatooine with his brother in tow. The small attack force was comprised of three [[Kom'rk-class fighter/transport/Legends|''Kom'rk''-class starfighters]] loaded with squads of Death Watch foot soldiers, a lone [[Gozanti-class cruiser/Legends|Gozanti Cruiser]], and two [[Sarisa-class gunship/Legends|''Sarisa-class'' gunships]]. Completely taking Jabba and his men off guard, the ''Kom'rk'' starfighters laid suppressing fire on the palace, killing many outside, including two [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guards engaged in a leisurely game of arm wrestling. Death Watch foot soldiers were dispensed from the starfighters' underbellies, using their [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]] to fly to the palace and engage the inhabitants in close quartered combat; [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]] and wrist-mounted [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] found heavy use in the skirmish with members of various species, including [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]], [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]], and [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] thugs. Maul, Opress and Vizsla cut through the entry and made their way into Jabba's main audience chamber, with [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan]] and a few [[Unidentified Death Watch soldier (white helmet)/Legends|others]] close behind. When they met with the crime lord, Vizsla and Maul gave the Hutt one last chance to ally with them. Jabba merely laughed and spoke [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], and his [[Unidentified translation droid/Legends|translator droid]] stated that Jabba and the Hutt families would join them.<ref name="EMN" />

==Aftermath==
The Death Watch assisted with the cleanup of the palace, helping up Jabba's men, or at least, the ones who survived the skrimish. Maul and Vizsla finalized their plans for the [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|conquest]] the New Mandalorian [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] on Mandalore, [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]]. Maul stated that their army was complete and that they had enough resources, and he requested that Vizsla send a guard to Mandalore to find the places with the most security in Sundari. Vizsla then left Maul, and spoke with his [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan Kryze]]. He stated that once Mandalore was in their grasp, the two brothers would lie dead with the [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] of Mandalore, [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]],<ref name="EMN" /> Bo-Katan's sister.<ref name="thelaw">{{TCW|The Lawless}}</ref> The Hutt families then gave them some of Hutt enforcers made of red-skinned [[Nikto/Legends|Niktos]] which would later prove useful in the takeover of Mandalore and subsequent battle of Sundari.<ref name="ShadowConspiracy">''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The attack on Jabba's Palace first appeared in the young reader novel ''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]'', which adapted the episode "[[Eminence (episode)|Eminence]]" of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]]. The idea for the attack originally came from franchise creator [[George Lucas]] himself.<ref name="comment">{{SWArchive|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep514/#!/media/commentary|text=''Eminence'' featurette}}</ref>
